answer: Farming becomes a harbor bet on surviving 112 epochs of grading, and every ember settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 112 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
